test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: No person can disrespect the National flag, Constitution of India and the National Anthem under the ______ Act.

options.text: Prevention of Insults to National Honour

solution:
The correct answer is __**Prevention of Insults to National Honour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Act For Prevention of Insults to National Honour 1971:

__
 
• The law was enacted on December 23, 1971. 
 
• It penalises the desecration of or any insult to the national symbols like the National Flag, National Anthem, and Indian Map as well as the contempt of the Constitution of India. 

​Section 2 of the Act__

__
 
• THE PREVENTION OF INSULTS TO NATIONAL HONOUR ACT, 1971, was enacted by Parliament in the Twenty-second Year of the Republic of India. 
 
• According to this Act, Whoever in any public place or in any other place within public view burns, mutilates, defaces, defiles, disfigures, destroys, tramples upon, or (otherwise shows disrespect to or brings) into contempt (whether by words, either spoken or written, or by acts) the Indian National Flag or the Constitution of India or any part thereof, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Flag Code of India is a set of laws and conventions concerning the use, display, and hoisting of the Indian national flag in the country. 
 
• The Flag Code of India, 2002 was amended on December 30, 2021, which allowed the use of polyester or machine-made flags. Thus, the National Flag can now be made in cotton, polyester, wool, silk or khadi. It can be woven by hand or made by a machine.
